The overlapping involvement of Gabra4 and Gabra6 in Gaba Receptor Activity suggests a potential role for Pentobarbital in modulating Gaba receptor function, possibly through a mechanism that involves the regulation of Gabra5. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible functional link between Pentobarbital and Gabra5, mediated by the Gaba Receptor Activity pathway.
